systems.owner: the Siun community, supported by the UK FCDO Digital Access Programme and the Initiative for Digital Inclusion
systems.tiers: one community in Obafemi Owode Local Government Area, Ogun State; one of ten such hubs, others operating in Kaduna, Kwara, Abia and Ogun States

note: A community-owned internet hub for residents; the local government area is only its location, and no local government office is said to be connected.
